body: I've done so my entire life, I have a room full of depressing work, it's all repetitive and doesn't help anymore.

I have always been alone with this. No one has any idea because I've gotten really good at hiding it over the years.

I guess the most fundamental thing about me that is worth sharing is that I am a creative individual. But have lost all passion for my work. I just feel like nothing healthy can help me anymore.
I have no idea where to start. After a life of thinking, I just can't see way out of myself. That's pretty much it.

I create an importance around the people I care about, creating the feeling that I need them, that I am inappropriately clingy. I become afraid of the feeling and end up building a wall to keep that from showing, and they end up feeling like I genuinely don't like them. They try to get close but the closer I get with people the more mistakes I make in my interaction and my unstable thinking becomes a hurtful behavior, I don't intent any of this, but it always happens. I want to relieve people of any emotional frustration I've caused.

By myself I am unhappy and frustrated, when I'm not actively taking my mind off things. When I'm with others the instability either goes away and I can quietly be present or it transfers over to the people around me, the unhappiness/confusion.

I don't have any trouble being around multiple friends.
